text: A Lament for the Princes of Israel

segments.text: As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
and say:
‘What was your mother? A lioness among the lions! She lay down among the young lions; she reared her cubs.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: When the nations heard of him, he was trapped in their pit. With hooks they led him away to the land of Egypt.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their cities. The land and everything in it shuddered at the sound of his roaring.
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or He knew their widows or He seized their widows

segments.text: Then the nations set out against him from the provinces on every side. They spread their net over him; he was trapped in their pit.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: With hooks they caged him and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into captivity so that his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of the abundant waters.
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Some Hebrew manuscripts; most Hebrew manuscripts in your bloodline

segments.text: It had strong branches, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick branches, conspicuous for its height and for its dense foliage.
segments.speaker: The LORD
The LORD

segments.text: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Fire has gone out from its main branch and devoured its fruit; on it no strong branch remains fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ This is a lament and shall be used as a lament.
segments.speaker: The LORD
